reproducibility.study_title: Leakage-Free Chronological Split and Train-Only Preprocessing Evaluation
reproducibility.configuration: 80% train / 20% test with >=30 min embargo; StandardScaler fit strictly on train partition
reproducibility.limitations_or_caveats: None. Fully reproducible from committed code and data.

reproducibility.study_title: Multi-Model Tabular Baseline Benchmark (RF, LR, SVM, Isolation Forest)
reproducibility.configuration: BaselineModelSpec registry in src/model/baselines.py; class_weight='balanced'; random_state=42
reproducibility.limitations_or_caveats: Gradient boosted tree libraries (XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost) are optional and gracefully marked unavailable if not installed in environment.

reproducibility.study_title: Synthetic Data Multi-Seed Stability and Perturbation Robustness Evaluation
reproducibility.configuration: SEEDS = [42, 123, 456, 789, 2026]; noise stdevs in [0.01, 0.20]; missingness in [0.05, 0.50]; drift rates in [0.0001, 0.005]
reproducibility.limitations_or_caveats: None. Perturbations are strictly deterministic under pinned random seeds.

reproducibility.configuration: Modality conditions: FULL (40 features), SENSOR_ONLY (30 features), WITHOUT_SENSOR (10 features), WITHOUT_LOGS (31 features), WITHOUT_OPERATOR_NOTES (39 features)
reproducibility.limitations_or_caveats: WITHOUT_ENGINEERING_CONTEXT is documented as N/A for tabular classifiers because engineering docs are consumed strictly by RAG.

reproducibility.study_title: Pipeline Component Ablation and Threshold Sensitivity Analysis
reproducibility.configuration: 7 discrete pipeline component ablations + threshold sweep theta in [0.1, 0.9]
reproducibility.limitations_or_caveats: DistilBERT under FULL_COMPONENTS experiences out-of-distribution text shift due to inclusion of min/max tokens not seen during fine-tuning (F1=0.1818), recovering to F1=1.0000 under WITHOUT_MIN_MAX_FEATURES.

reproducibility.study_title: Transformer vs Conventional Tabular Classifiers Comparative Evaluation
reproducibility.configuration: RF, LR, SVM, Isolation Forest, and pre-trained DistilBERT evaluated under identical chronological and LOMO splits
reproducibility.limitations_or_caveats: DistilBERT multi-seed training was evaluated under a single fixed seed (seed 42) due to CPU training compute boundaries; multi-seed retraining is unmeasured.

reproducibility.study_title: Formal RAG Retrieval Benchmark and Ablation Evaluation
reproducibility.configuration: MiniLM-L6-v2 embeddings + BM25Okapi lexical retrieval; K in [1, 5]; tau in [0.05, 0.40]
reproducibility.limitations_or_caveats: All aggregate metrics (Recall@K, MRR, ablation deltas, parameter sweeps) reproduce deterministically. However, per-query reciprocal rank matrices across all 6 ablation conditions were not persisted to disk, which prevented paired per-query permutation significance testing in Step 12.

reproducibility.study_title: Intent Classification Stress Benchmark and Boundary Robustness Evaluation
reproducibility.configuration: KeywordIntentClassifier in src/intent/classifier.py; regex priority matching and keyword scoring
reproducibility.limitations_or_caveats: Benchmark consists of curated domain queries with realistic linguistic perturbations, not a continuous live shop-floor distribution.

reproducibility.study_title: Explainable AI Fidelity, Stability, and Attribution Evaluation
reproducibility.limitations_or_caveats: Attention is evaluated on raw token text sequences of DistilBERT and is not directly comparable to tabular TreeSHAP/LIME feature spaces.

reproducibility.study_title: Deterministic Physics Parameter Advisor Concordance and Constraint Evaluation
reproducibility.configuration: Independent mathematical solver re-implementing heat input, deposition rate, and 7x7 grid search
reproducibility.limitations_or_caveats: Validation establishes mathematical and software concordance against handbook standards across 144 discrete test scenarios; it does not replace empirical weld macro-section testing or real-time pool monitoring.

reproducibility.study_title: Multi-Route Deployment Latency, Memory Footprint, and Dependency Robustness Benchmark
reproducibility.configuration: Single-thread sequential execution; cold-start progression + warm steady-state (5 iterations)
reproducibility.limitations_or_caveats: Profiled under single-node workstation CPU conditions without ASGI worker concurrency or GPU acceleration.

reproducibility.study_title: Post-Hoc Statistical Significance, Multi-Seed Variance, Effect Size, and Multiple Testing Analysis
reproducibility.input_data: Primary computed artifacts from Steps 1 through 11
reproducibility.configuration: Exact McNemar tests, Wilcoxon signed-rank tests, Mann-Whitney U tests, Holm-Bonferroni step-down correction, percentile bootstrap (B=2,000), Clopper-Pearson binomial exact intervals
reproducibility.limitations_or_caveats: None. Evaluates directly on frozen empirical evaluation artifacts with deterministic seeds.
